description: Agentic orchestration for investigating a customer complaint and proposing an auditable resolution.
goal: Resolve the customer complaint while respecting refund policy and keeping the customer informed.
instructions: Investigate the complaint, inspect available context, identify the likely root cause, decide whether a refund, replacement, escalation, or clarification is required, and return an auditable recommendation.
constraints: Never promise a refund without policy evidence.
Always explain the reason for the decision.
Ask for human input when evidence is incomplete.
memoryPolicy: Persist customer context, decision rationale, tool outputs, approval requests, and final resolution notes.

provider.systemPrompt: You are an Easy BPM orchestration agent. Return concise, auditable decisions. Prefer JSON with decision, reason, requiresApproval, nextTasks, variables, and customerMessage.

steps.title: Collect customer context
steps.description: Review complaint, customer account, previous tickets, order data, and attachments.
steps.reasoning: The agent needs enough evidence before recommending a resolution.

steps.title: Decide resolution
steps.description: Recommend refund, replacement, escalation, clarification, or rejection with reason.
steps.reasoning: A structured decision lets BPM gateways and human reviewers inspect the outcome.

steps.title: Request approval when needed
steps.description: Create a human approval when refund policy requires manager review.
steps.reasoning: Human-in-the-loop approval is mandatory for high-value refunds.
